\\\"none\\\"}`);\\n\\n      const requestClassification = modelSelector.classifyQuestion(\\n        effectivePrompt,\\n        request.references\\n      );\\n\\n      // Deprecation warning system - NEW in v1.3.0\\n      if (effectivePrompt.includes(\\\"legacy_format:\\\") || effectivePrompt.includes(\\\"v1_output\\\")) {\\n        response.markdown(`⚠️ **DEPRECATED**: Legacy output format detected. \\\"(none)\\\";\\n          outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] request.model: id=\\\"${reqModelId}\\\" vendor=\\\"${reqModelVendor}\\\"`);\\n\\n          const matchedModel = models.find((m) => m.id === reqModelId);\\n          if (matchedModel) {\\n            selected = matchedModel;\\n            outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] Honoring selected model by ID: ${selected.id}`);\\n          } else if (reqModelVendor === \\\"lmstudio\\\") {\\n            // If VS Code handed us a vendor-owned LM Studio model that is not in the cache yet,\\n            // keep the user's selection rather than auto-switching away.\\n            selected = request.model;\\n            outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] Using vendor-selected lmstudio model directly: ${selected.id}`);\\n          } else {\\n            const knownIds = models.map(m => m.id).slice(0, 10).join(\\\", \\\");\\n            outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] request.model \\\"${reqModelId}\\\" (vendor=\\\"${reqModelVendor}\\\") is not an LM Studio model. \\\"none\\\"}`);\\n\\n      const requestClassification = modelSelector.classifyQuestion(\\n        effectivePrompt,\\n        request.references\\n      );\\n\\n      // Deprecation warning system - NEW in v1.3.0\\n      if (effectivePrompt.includes(\\\"legacy_format:\\\") || effectivePrompt.includes(\\\"v1_output\\\")) {\\n        response.markdown(`⚠️ **DEPRECATED**: Legacy output format detected. \\\"(none)\\\";\\n          outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] request.model: id=\\\"${reqModelId}\\\" vendor=\\\"${reqModelVendor}\\\"`);\\n\\n          const matchedModel = models.find((m) => m.id === reqModelId);\\n          if (matchedModel) {\\n            selected = matchedModel;\\n            outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] Honoring selected model by ID: ${selected.id}`);\\n          } else if (reqModelVendor === \\\"lmstudio\\\") {\\n            // If VS Code handed us a vendor-owned LM Studio model that is not in the cache yet,\\n            // keep the user's selection rather than auto-switching away.\\n            selected = request.model;\\n            outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] Using vendor-selected lmstudio model directly: ${selected.id}`);\\n          } else {\\n            const knownIds = models.map(m => m.id).slice(0, 10).join(\\\", \\\");\\n            outputChannel.appendLine(`[MODEL SELECT] request.model \\\"${reqModelId}\\\" (vendor=\\\"${reqModelVendor}\\\") is not an LM Studio model.
